calculation.description: Measures the acceleration of each instrument's 10-trading-day return relative to its preceding 10-trading-day return, normalized by 30-day annualized realized volatility. Positive values indicate strengthening upward trends; negative values indicate weakening or accelerating downward trends. All inputs are lagged or rolling using information available at the signal date.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2033-10-26 available data; signal observations with forward returns through 2033-10-12
validation.regime_notes: Revalidation failed benchmark admission at the 10-day horizon: absolute IC 0.00342 < 0.007 and absolute ICIR 0.01069 < 0.084. Predictive sign varied by regime; deprecate pending future re-emergence.

signal_provenance.method: daily Spearman cross-sectional correlation of signal with forward close-to-close returns
